run_show_samples_greedy: run the script to show tourist language model samples using greedy decoding strategy
run_show_samples_beam: run the script to show tourist language model samples using beam search decoding
load_TouristLanguage_model: load a TouristLanguage model checkpoint from a saved path using TouristLanguage.load
load_TalkTheWalkLanguage_data: load the TalkTheWalkLanguage training dataset using TalkTheWalkLanguage with a data directory path
show_samples_method: call show_samples on a TouristLanguage model to display predictions for given data indices
